source.label: Synthetic daily operational KPI output
source.sql: SELECT * FROM daily_kpis ORDER BY request_date
caveats: All records, cutoff times, SLAs, owners, clients, and workflow rules are fictional portfolio assumptions.
This artifact has no connection to bank systems or production settlement data.

metricDefinitions.label: Completion rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed requests divided by all requests for the business date.

metricDefinitions.label: SLA breach rate
metricDefinitions.definition: SLA-breached eligible requests divided by eligible requests for the business date.

metricDefinitions.label: Cutoff risk count
metricDefinitions.definition: Requests classified WATCH or AT_RISK; BREACHED is reported separately.

evidenceFlow.title: Validate
evidenceFlow.detail: Reject malformed timestamps, currencies, statuses, priorities, owners, SLA values, and cutoff times.

evidenceFlow.title: Aggregate
evidenceFlow.detail: Calculate timezone-aware cutoff risk, SLA states, aging, exceptions, and KPI outputs.
